_comment: T’au Empire Faction Pack v1.2. Complete datasheet, army rule, detachment and enhancement rules.

For the Greater Good.note: Observer unit marks visible enemy as Spotted. Guided units gain +1 BS and [IGNORES COVER] (if Markerlight) against Spotted unit (-1 BS vs non-spotted).

Patient Hunter.note: Rounds 3+: ranged attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. While Guided, ignore modifiers to BS and Hit rolls against Spotted unit.

Killing Blow.note: Rounds 1-3: ranged weapons have [ASSAULT]. While Guided, ranged attacks have [LETHAL HITS].

Bonded Heroes.note: Battlesuit models: +1 S to ranged attacks within 12", +1 AP within 8".

Hunter’s Instincts.note: Kroot attacks: +1 to Hit if target is below Starting Strength, and +1 to Wound if Below Half-strength.

Skirmish Fighters.note: Kroot models have 6+ invulnerable save against melee attacks and 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

Coldstar Commander.note: While leading a unit, models have Move 12" and ranged weapons have [ASSAULT].

Enforcer Commander.note: While leading a unit, worsen Armour Penetration of ranged attacks targeting that unit by 1.

Volley Fire.note: While leading a unit, add 1 to Attacks of ranged weapons.

Crack Shot.note: On a Critical Wound with ranged attack, that attack has AP -3.

Way of the Short Blade.note: While leading a unit, attacks targeting enemy within 9" add 1 to Wound roll.

Failure Is Not an Option.note: While leading a unit, models have Feel No Pain 5+.

Coordinated Leadership.note: At end of Command phase, roll D6: on 4+, gain 1CP.

Structural Analyser.note: While leading a unit, ranged attacks add 1 to Wound roll.

Breach and Clear.note: Ranged attacks targeting enemy within range of objective marker re-roll Wound roll.

Armour Hunter.note: Ranged attacks targeting MONSTER or VEHICLE add 1 to Hit roll.

Sunforge.note: Ranged attacks targeting MONSTER or VEHICLE re-roll Wound roll and Damage roll.

Fireknife.note: Ranged attacks re-roll Hit roll of 1; if target is at Starting Strength, re-roll Hit roll.

Starscythe.note: Ranged attacks (excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES) improve AP by 1.

Velocity Tracker.note: Ranged attacks targeting FLY unit re-roll Hit roll.

Ground Strike Fighter.note: Ranged attacks targeting enemy that cannot FLY add 1 to Hit roll.

Titan-killer.note: Ranged attacks targeting TITANIC or TOWERING re-roll Hit roll.

Weapon Support System.note: Ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll for ranged attacks.

Support System.note: Ignore any or all modifiers to the Hit roll.

Hero of the Empire (Aura).note: Friendly T’AU EMPIRE units within 6" re-roll Hit rolls of 1 on ranged attacks.

Command-link Drone (Aura).note: While within 6", each time you target a friendly T’AU EMPIRE unit with a Stratagem, roll D6: on 5+, gain 1CP.

Advanced Guardian Drone.note: Each time a ranged attack targets bearer, subtract 1 from Wound roll.

Agile Combatant.note: Eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Battlesuit Support System.note: Eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.

Forward Observers.note: When this unit is Observer, Guided units targeting the Spotted unit re-roll Hit rolls of 1 and Wound rolls of 1.

Target Uploaded.note: Can be Observer even if already shot, and can mark up to two enemy units as Spotted.

Precise Targeting.note: Each time a model makes an attack targeting a Spotted unit, re-roll the Hit roll.

Exemplars of Mont’ka.note: Ranged attacks targeting closest eligible target have [SUSTAINED HITS 1] and [IGNORES COVER].

Rites of Feasting.note: While leading a unit, models have Feel No Pain 6+ (5+ if unit destroyed enemy in Fight phase).

Hover Drone.note: Bearer can FLY and has Move characteristic of 10".

Pech’ra.note: Ranged weapons equipped by bearer’s unit have [IGNORES COVER].

Oversight Drone.note: Once per battle, ranged weapons have [IGNORES COVER].

Fieldcraft.note: Objective marker remains under control even if no models within range (sticky objective).

Stealth Drones.note: Twice per battle, change Damage of an allocated attack to 0.

Nova Charge.note: Once per battle, selected ranged weapon gains [DEVASTATING WOUNDS].

Targeting Array.note: Each time selected to shoot, re-roll one Hit roll or one Wound roll.

Puretide's Teachings.note: Once per battle round, reduce CP cost of a Stratagem by 1CP.

War Leader.note: Once per battle round, reduce CP cost of a Stratagem by 1CP.

INDEPENDENT POWER.note: Cannot include Ethereal units if army includes Commander Farsight.

Jammer Array.note: Enemy units from Reserves cannot set up within 12".

Grav-inhibitor Drone.note: Subtract 2 from Charge rolls made for enemy units declaring a charge against this unit.

Pulse Accelerator Drone.note: Add 6" to Range of pulse carbines.

Recon Drone.note: Bearer equipped with drone burst cannon and unit has Infiltrators.

Drone Harassment Tactics.note: End of Movement phase, enemy within 12" takes Battle-shock test.

Rapid Deployment.note: Units can disembark after Devilfish Advances.

Advanced Armour.note: Feel No Pain 4+ against mortal wounds.

Advanced Scouting.note: Ranged hits allow other Kroot models to re-roll Hit rolls against that enemy until end of turn.

Fire and Fade.note: After shooting, can make Normal move up to 6" (cannot charge).

Kroot Linebreakers.note: End of Charge move: roll D6 per model within Engagement Range; on 4+ inflict D3 mortal wounds.

Kroot Packmates.note: When friendly Kroot Infantry within 6" is targeted by enemy shooting, shoot back at that enemy.

Loping Pounce.note: Eligible to charge in a turn in which it Advanced if within 6" of Kroot Infantry.

Hunting Hounds.note: OC is 1 while within 12" of friendly Kroot Character.

Trail Finding.note: Opponent's Movement phase: enemy ends move within 8", make Normal move up to D6".

Kroot Ambush.note: After deployment, redeploy this unit and one other friendly Kroot unit into Strategic Reserves.

Root of Honour.note: Once per battle, select friendly Kroot unit within 12" that is Battle-shocked: it is no longer Battle-shocked.

Bounty Hunters.note: Select one enemy unit at start of battle: attacks against it have [LETHAL HITS] and [PRECISION].

Neocapacitor Shields.note: Start of opponent's Charge phase: enemy within 12" takes Battle-shock test and -1 to Charge rolls.

Retro-thrusters.note: End of Fight phase: Normal move up to 6" or Fall Back.

Airborne Agility.note: End of opponent's turn, place into Strategic Reserves.

Homing Beacon.note: Once per battle, Rapid Ingress Stratagem for 0CP within 3" and > 8" away from enemy.

Pulse Bombs.note: End of opponent's Fight phase, roll 6 D6: each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound to visible enemy within 24".

Suppression Volley.note: After shooting, enemy INFANTRY hit is suppressed: -1 to Hit rolls until start of next turn.

DS8 Support Turret.note: If unit Remains Stationary, equipped with support turret missile system.

BODYGUARD.note: If starting strength 20, can attach up to two Leader units.

Heavy Walker.note: Can move over models and terrain 4" or less in height.

Droneport.note: Shoots drone defender weapons against every eligible target.

Fortification.note: Rules for enemy units engaged only with Fortifications.

Tidewall Cover.note: Models not fully visible have Benefit of Cover.

One Shot.note: Can only shoot with this weapon once per battle.

MV15 Gun Drone.note: Bearer equipped with twin pulse blaster.

Precision of the Patient Hunter.note: +1 to Hit on ranged attacks (+1 to Wound from round 3 onwards).

Through Unity, Devastation.note: While Observer, Guided unit gains [LETHAL HITS] against Spotted unit.

Coordinated Exploitation.note: While Observer, Guided unit gains [SUSTAINED HITS 1] against Spotted unit.

Exemplar of the Kauyon.note: Patient Hunter applies from second battle round onwards.

Exemplar of the Mont’ka.note: Killing Blow applies during fourth battle round as well.

Strike Swiftly.note: Up to two friendly units gain Scouts 6".

Internal Grenade Racks.note: GRENADES keyword; moving over enemy inflicts mortal wounds on 4+.

Prototype Weapon System.note: Ranged weapons gain [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

Starflare Ignition System.note: End of opponent's turn, place into Strategic Reserves.

Borthrod Gland.note: Melee attacks score Critical Hits on unmodified 5+.

Kroothawk Flock.note: Ranged weapons have [IGNORES COVER]; 12" deep strike denial.

Solid-image Projection Unit.note: Redeploy up to three units into Strategic Reserves.

Student of Kauyon.note: Up to 3 Kroot Carnivore/Farstalker units gain Deep Strike.

Admired Leader.note: Command phase: Kroot/Vespid within 12" gets +1 Ld and OC.

Thermoneutronic Projector.note: T'au Flamer has +2 S, +1 AP and D.

Plasma Accelerator Rifle.note: Plasma Rifle has +2 S, +1 A, AP and D.

Supernova Launcher.note: Airbursting Frag Projector has +3 S, +1 AP and D.

Unmasking Suite.note: Enemy unit has +9" detection range until this unit shoots.

KEYWORDS.note: Kroot Carnivore units have the Battleline keyword.

Integrated Command Structure.note: Auxiliary Cadre rules for Kroot and Vespid.

Superior Craftsmanship.note: Battlesuit Character ranged attacks have +6" Range.

Expert Fieldcraft.note: Shooting attacks do not prevent unit from being hidden.
